additional_info.subject: RE: ID0438635-DC/Si-D/IE- [MP / S2 170003301] Non start of charging session CRM:02684000413
additional_info.body:
Dear Colin Barry,
We’ve reviewed the error messages received during the session and conducted a diagnostic check on the charger.
During the session failure on 17/07/2025 at 09:56 AM (UTC) the session was not started because:
1. EV errorcode changed to: EV charge connector lock fault.
It indicates a fault in the locking mechanism between the EV and the charger. This can originate either from the EV’s connector lock system or the charger’s locking mechanism.
To help identify the source of the fault, we recommend:
Trying your EV at a different charger. If the issue persists, it may be EV-related.
Trying a different EV at the same charger. If the error reoccurs, the fault may be with the charger.
Another error was reported:
2. Parameter Discovery Failed: Wrong EV Parameters
This indicates that the charger was unable to correctly read or validate the EV’s charging parameters during the initial handshake.
I verified the recent charging session at Connector 4, which was successfully started on 2025-07-19 at 12:44:07.(UTC)
This confirms that the connector is functioning properly, and the issue is likely related to the EV or its communication with the charger.
If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to reach out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -Ankita

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0438635-DC/Si-D/IE- [MP / S2 170003301] Non start of charging session CRM:02684000413
additional_info.body:
Dear Colin Barry,
We have reviewed the logs related to your reported charging session and would like to share our findings:
Session Verification:
The session ID you provided does not match any session recorded in our system. Could you please confirm if the charger serial number mentioned in your ticket is correct? For your reference, we have attached the session we have recorded on our end.
Session Failures:
The first session was stopped due to a cable temperature error.
The second session was terminated by a
RemoteStopTransaction
command.
Regarding the other cable temperature-related issue, we are escalating this case to our technical experts for deeper analysis.
Please let us know if you have any additional information that might help with the investigation.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -Ankita
